description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing and testing Loan COB (Close of Business) catch-up processes within the Fineract integration test suite. It includes methods to check if catch-up is running, if it has finished for a specific date, and to execute catch-up actions and retrieve status information.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpHelper
classes.description: Helper class for performing COB catch-up related actions and checks during integration testing of the Loan module in Fineract.

methods.name: isLoanCOBCatchUpRunning
methods.description: Checks if the COB catch-up process is currently running.

methods.name: isLoanCOBCatchUpFinishedFor
methods.description: Determines if the COB catch-up process has finished for a specific business date.

methods.name: executeRetrieveOldestCOBProcessedLoan
methods.description: Retrieves information about the oldest COB processed loan record.

methods.name: executeGetLoanCatchUpStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the COB catch-up process.
